381YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.d: The Golden Pyramid held precedence with 83 members. Gregor was re-appointed Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern and Raewynn Farkas became Grandmaster of the Silver Chalice. Rivers Run Red and Mountain Remembers Its Youth were interdicted, while Hallow of the Green World was reconciled. Concords thanked Lord Adamant and invited his koboldi to aid the Empire. Others sent magicians to teach the Great Forest orcs after the Druj's damage and affirmed the treaty with them. Rivers of Life and Blessing of New Spring were disseminated to those orcs. Richard of Holberg was asked to design a mana sinecure in Morrow and a magical structure in Tassato. Helios's candidacy for Autumn Archmage was defeated.

n.Dawn: Mentioned in passing: Kay Carter of Dawn provided the 10 thrones for disseminating Blessing of New Spring to the orcs of the Great Forest.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: a concord sent Conclave magicians to help the Great Forest orcs overcome the damage the Druj had done to them.
n.Highguard: The Conclave passed a concord inviting Gilean, herald of Llofir, to return to Highguard.
n.The League: League magicians of Tassato were active: Arsenio Rezia di Tassato carried the concord welcoming Lord Adamant's koboldi, and Erasmo di Tassato won support for a magical structure in Tassato.
n.Urizen: A concord seeking support to pursue the matter of horses and Medea of Urizen failed. Another passed asking Richard of Holberg to design a mana sinecure in Urizen-held Morrow.

t.Morrow: Gorion of Phoenix Reach's concord passed, calling for Richard of Holberg to design a mana sinecure in Morrow.
t.Tassato: Erasmo di Tassato's concord passed, calling for Richard of Holberg to design a magical structure in Tassato.

381YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: New senators were returned for Semmerholm, Casinea, Therunin and Volodmartz. Robert Dunlain took the Mournwold seat the Senate had allocated to the Marches. Redoubt and Zenith were contested after their previous senators were revoked; Redoubt elected Marissa of Shattered Spire and Zenith re-elected its previous incumbent. Veikko of Wintermark and Viviane de Coeurdefer of Dawn became Cardinals of Loyalty and Ambition, and Azekah of Highguard kept Pride. The four great Imperial Bourse seats sold for 350 to 375 thrones each. The Singing Caves in Mournwold, newly conquered, awaited Senate allocation as an Imperial or national title. The Legacy in Spiral was unavailable while Grendel held it.

n.Dawn: Lady Josline Arwood became senator for Semmerholm and Viviane de Coeurdefer was elected Cardinal of Ambition. Ranae de Rondell kept her post as Virtue Inquisitor of Ambition, and Dawnish military unit captains appointed Maryc Orzel unopposed as Castellan of Spiral Castle.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: the Legacy in Spiral could not be appointed this season because it was in Grendel hands.
n.Highguard: Nira of Cantiarch's Hold became senator for Casinea and Azekah of Highguard kept the seat of Cardinal of Pride. Sister Magdelana of the Shattered Tower was named Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial.
n.Navarr: Cybi Farkas was elected senator for Therunin, and Corwin Leafstalker of Navarr stayed on as Virtue Inquisitor of Loyalty.
n.The Brass Coast: The incumbent senator for Kahraman held the seat.
n.The League: The senator for Tassato kept the seat, and Astrid Fjellrevening Rezia di Tassato stayed on as Gatekeeper of Pride. Illaria Notturno di Sarvos of the League became Quaymaster of the Black Sails.
n.The Marches: Robert Dunlain took the Mournwold Senate seat allocated to the Marches, and the senator for Upwold kept the seat. Tess of the Marches stayed on as Gatekeeper of Loyalty, and the Singing Caves in Mournwold awaited Senate allocation after their conquest.
n.Urizen: After the previous senators for Redoubt and Zenith were revoked, Marissa of Shattered Spire won Redoubt and Zenith re-elected its previous incumbent; Morrow's senator kept the seat. Galene Netherwatch of Urizen became Virtue Inquisitor of Wisdom.
n.Varushka: Asya olya Vickentivich was elected senator for Volodmartz, and Varushkan mine owners returned Tomasz unopposed to the Eternal Shafts of Time.
n.Wintermark: Veikko of Wintermark became Cardinal of Loyalty, Rane Jorunsdottir kept the post of Virtue Inquisitor of Pride, and Gunnbrand Ironwill became Watcher of Britta's Pool. The senator for Hahnmark kept the seat, and military unit captains chose Algar of Ashenhall for the Pride of Ikka's Tears by 14 votes.

t.Casinea: Nira of Cantiarch's Hold was elected senator for Casinea.
t.Hahnmark: The incumbent senator for Hahnmark held the seat.
t.Kahraman: The incumbent senator for Kahraman held the seat.
t.Morrow: The incumbent senator for Morrow held the seat.
t.Mournwold: The Senate allocated Mournwold's seat to the Marches, and Robert Dunlain was elected to it. The Singing Caves, newly conquered, could be made an Imperial or national title by the Senate.
t.Redoubt: The previous senator for Redoubt was revoked, and Marissa of Shattered Spire was elected in their place.
t.Semmerholm: Lady Josline Arwood was elected senator for Semmerholm.
t.Spiral: The Legacy in Spiral could not be appointed while Grendel held it, though Dawnish captains named Maryc Orzel Castellan of Spiral Castle.
t.Tassato: The incumbent senator for Tassato held the seat.
t.Therunin: Cybi Farkas was elected senator for Therunin.
t.Upwold: The incumbent senator for Upwold held the seat.
t.Volodmartz: Asya olya Vickentivich was elected senator for Volodmartz.
t.Zenith: The previous senator for Zenith was revoked but was then re-elected to the seat.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: The national assemblies split over the Varushkan Iron Helms. Wintermark and the Freeborn rejected them, the League's priests spoke against fear as a weapon, and Dawn, Highguard and Urizen joined Navarr and Varushka in sanctioning cruelty. Highguard stood by Yael after the Synod executed her for heresy. Broken Shore orcs raided the Bay of Catazar and Imperial fleets struck back. Many eternals made offers or sought parley, and the Senate's Silver Chalice order neared establishment. Opportunities arose in the Mournwold, Sarvos and Therunin. Six Summer mandates took effect, including a ban on Marcher armies giving ground. Resources in Liathaven suffered the Conquered Territories penalty.

n.Dawn: Dawn's assembly sanctioned the Iron Helms' cruelty, and its mandate formally repudiated Yael's teachings. Meanwhile the eternal Eleonaris made her displeasure with the Dawnish clear, and an antique artefact of a famous Dawnish enchanter appeared at the Winter Market.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Great Forest orcs now in Therunin are described as exiles who fled the Druj.
n.Highguard: The Highborn alone stood by Yael after her execution, leaving the founding nation of the Way at doctrinal odds with the rest of the Empire. Their assembly also sanctioned battlefield cruelty, and Highborn resource owners in Highguard gained a production boost for as long as they do not reject the Land Without Tears.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named, but Liathaven, which they held, saw Imperial resources there suffer the Conquered Territories penalty.
n.Navarr: The Navarr assembly's mandate gave the general of the Quiet Step the chance to make the army permanently cunning. Therunin's Navarr faced the repercussions of the Senate's treaty with the displaced Great Forest orcs.
n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn assembly rejected the Iron Helms, and its mandate imposed penalties on that army when it fights alongside Freeborn armies. The Freeborn were also tagged in the orc pirate raids on the Bay of Catazar and a theft from Serra Briante.
n.The League: League priests spoke against using fear as a weapon, though not unanimously, and the assembly set out principles for rebuilding and securing Sarvos. Lorenzo 'La Volpe' von Temeschwar's name was on everyone's lips.
n.The Marches: The Marcher mandate means no Marcher general can ever again issue the Give Ground order. The nation also faced a double-length opportunity over the Mournwold and news of a fallen star in the Marches.
n.Urizen: The Urizen assembly joined those sanctioning the use of cruelty and fear on the battlefield, in support of the Iron Helms.
n.Varushka: The Varushkan mandate let the Iron Helms take the Terror in the Night order until the start of Spring 382YE, even as several nations rejected the army. The traditional Varushkan Winter Market drew rare goods to Anvil.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's assembly rejected the Iron Helms, and its mandate gave Wintermark armies extra orders alongside them while the Iron Helms suffer penalties when fighting with Wintermark armies. The seal-folk of Sermersuaq and their blessing also featured in the season's magical news.

t.Bay of Catazar: Broken Shore orc pirates raided the bay twice, first attacking its fisherfolk and then trying to enslave the people of the Isle of Zemress. Imperial fleet captains answered with counter-raids.
t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: a grateful Holberg architect has an offer for the Conclave.
t.Kahraman: A theft from Serra Briante in Kahraman was one of three Bourse-related situations offering opportunities or threats.
t.Liathaven: Resources in Liathaven received the Conquered Territories penalty to their production.
t.Miekarova: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova is not named on the page, which concerns Varushka only through the Iron Helms and the Winter Market.
t.Mournwold: The complicated situation in the Mournwold produced a double-length opportunity over what could and should be done there.
t.Sarvos: The League assembly set out principles for rebuilding and securing Sarvos and condemned the Iron Helms, who had just spent three months in the city. There was also an update on the orcs at the College of the Liberated.
t.Sermersuaq: The seal-folk of Sermersuaq and their blessing featured in the season's magical roundup, which was especially relevant to the territory's people.
t.Temeschwar: Mentioned in passing: the territory appears in the name and titles of Lorenzo 'La Volpe' von Temeschwar, Treasurer of the Bloody Butchers of Temeschwar.
t.Therunin: The Great Forest orcs who fled the Druj into Therunin faced the repercussions of the treaty the Senate ratified at the Summer Solstice to define their relationship with the Empire.

r.Kahraman/Serra Briante: A theft from Serra Briante was one of three Bourse-related situations raised this season.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: In Spiral, League and Urizen armies drove the Grendel from Cinion, and the Wolves of War and Red Wind Corsairs plundered the Legacy's mithril caravan. The Grendel collapsed most passes from Redoubt, and the Black Plateau began to stir. The Golden Sun routed the husks in Weirwater. The Freeborn Storm was beaten back to Rebekah's Leap. Three Highborn armies lost over a thousand soldiers covering the evacuation of Zenith as the Druj and the cruel Black Wind advanced. Marcher-led armies liberated Ore Hills, Greensward and Alderly, returning the Mournwold to Imperial control. The Druj conquered Axmure and razed the Gate. Four Sentinel Gate conjunctions were identified.

n.Dawn: The Golden Sun and over forty captains crushed the husk host in Weirwater for around four hundred losses. Meanwhile the Druj overran Axmure and razed the Gate, raising fears that Dawn may struggle to support all four of its armies.
n.Druj: Druj armies conquered Axmure, destroyed the Gate and took Lustri and Occursion. In Proceris, their cruel Black Wind army pushed the Highborn back at heavy cost to both sides.
n.Grendel: The Grendel were driven from Cinion and lost the Legacy's mithril caravan to Imperial raiders. They collapsed most passes into Spiral, plundered its southern regions for wealth and slaves, and outfought the Freeborn Storm at sea.
n.Highguard: The Valiant Pegasus, Granite Pillar and Seventh Wave held Zenith in a disciplined fighting retreat, losing over a thousand soldiers to cover the Urizen evacuation. They now risk breaking under the Black Wind's merciless onslaught.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Winter Sun and Summer Storm fought in the Mournwold and helped distribute Senate aid to orc thralls, but met a frosty welcome from Mournwolders. Separately, an Imperial Orc trader was lynched in Semmerholm after being mistaken for a Druj spy.
n.Jotun: The Jotun lost the Tribute, Ore Hills, Greensward and Alderly, leaving only Green March and Southmoor. Their remaining forces are concentrated at Hillstop, while Navarr scouts kept them chasing shadows in Liathaven.
n.Navarr: Cloaked in Night magic, the Black Thorns slipped the Jotun noose in Liathaven and routed the Jotun in Alderly. The Quiet Step made a fifth of the progress needed to liberate Beacon Point.
n.The Brass Coast: With every Freeborn force in action, the Fire of the South held the Twilight Gate and the Red Wind Corsairs helped loot the Legacy. The Freeborn Storm suffered heavy losses and was driven back to Rebekah's Leap.
n.The League: The Wolves of War and Towerjacks helped clear Cinion, and the Wolves seized much of the Legacy's mithril as a reckoning for Sarvos. Holberg now faces being cut off if the Druj take Estmure.
n.The Marches: The Drakes, Strong Reeds, Tusks and Bounders retook three Mournwold regions, so the territory is again Imperial and can be assigned by the Senate. Marcher soldiers also distributed Imperial Breadbasket supplies to the liberated people.
n.Urizen: The Citadel Guard helped win back Cinion, but the Black Plateau is waking and the Grendel have sealed most passes. In Zenith, spires fell or were veiled, and civilians fled west as the Druj threatened the Golden Cascade.
n.Varushka: The Golden Axe fought in the Mournwold to a cool reception, and Varushkan wagon raiders joined the Wolves of War. Varushkan magicians wove the Night shroud that hid the Black Thorns.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark warriors fought alongside the Golden Sun in Weirwater. The Grape & The Grain coven wrapped Zenith in Autumn magic that aided refugees and defenders alike, though it helped the Druj too.

t.Bay of Catazar: The Freeborn Storm and over fifty independent captains sailed east to stop Grendel naval support in Spiral. They were outmanoeuvred by the Grendel armada, losing three ships for every Grendel vessel sunk.
t.Holberg: Refugees fled toward Holberg, which risks being cut off from the Empire if the Druj conquer Estmure. Only the Walls of Holberg and the dangerous mountains bar the orcs' way into the territory.
t.Kahraman: The Quiet Step marched through Kahraman into southern Liathaven. Some Mournwold yeomen fled south into the territory past Fort Braydon.
t.Karov: Mentioned in passing: the defeated husks retreated north from Culwich toward Karov.
t.Liathaven: The Black Thorns escaped encirclement under a Night shroud, and Quiet Step scouts harried Jotun supply lines in the north. The Quiet Step made early gains in Beacon Point.
t.Morrow: Mentioned in passing: a Saturday conjunction opens in northern Proceris not far from the border with Morrow.
t.Mournwold: Imperial armies liberated Ore Hills, Greensward and Alderly, returning the territory to Imperial control and opening it to a Senate motion of assignment. Anti-Imperial sentiment lingers, and the Jotun still hold Green March and Southmoor.
t.Redoubt: Grendel forces collapsed most army-sized passes from Redoubt into Spiral, leaving only the Onyx Path and the Crow Road on this side. The defeated Freeborn Storm retreated west into Redoubt's waters.
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: Highborn soldiers were spurred on by memories of what the Druj did to Reikos and its people.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: the general of the Wolves of War called the Spiral raid a reckoning for the Grendel's taking of Sarvos.
t.Semmerholm: The Druj invaded, conquered Axmure and destroyed the Gate after a month-long siege. Their raiders terrorised the territory, and nothing significant now stands between them and the rest of Semmerholm.
t.Spiral: The Empire drove the Grendel from Cinion, gained ground in Ankra and plundered the Legacy. Grendel pillaging cut personal resource production by a fifth, and the waking Black Plateau began adding to casualties.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step marched through Tassato, and some displaced Mournwold yeomen fled there.
t.The Semmerlak: Mentioned in passing: Holberg might be supplied by ship across the Semmerlak if cut off, and the Sandling conjunction opens near its shores.
t.Weirwater: The Golden Sun, the Knights of Glory and their allies defeated the husks in battles culminating outside Culwich. Much farmland was destroyed and smaller husk gangs remain at large.
t.Zenith: The Druj took Lustri and Occursion and advanced into Proceris, while Highguard armies covered the westward evacuation of spires. Rival citadels of black ice and woven trees were raised in Clypion and Lustri.

r.Holberg/Holmauer: Mentioned in passing: the dangerous mountains between Axmure and Holmauer are one of the only routes into Holberg other than the Walls.
r.Kahraman/Serra Damata: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step general's orders named an advance north from Serra Damata to Beacon Point.
r.Liathaven/Beacon Point: The Quiet Step entered Beacon Point, wiping out Jotun camps, and are perhaps a fifth of the way to liberating it.
r.Liathaven/Liath's Ring: The shrouded Black Thorns fled eastward through Liath's Ring, evading the Jotun on their way to the Mournwold.
r.Liathaven/Liaven's Glen: The Black Thorns passed through Liaven's Glen under their Night shroud before emerging into the Mournwold.
r.Liathaven/West Ranging: The Black Thorns began the season surrounded by the Jotun in West Ranging, then slipped out of the trap under a Varushkan Night shroud.
r.Mournwold/Alderly: Feni raids slowed the Empire in Alderly, until the Black Thorns surprised and routed the retreating Jotun. The region was secured, though its woods remain impassable to armies and its folk aloof.
r.Mournwold/Green March: Green March remains in Jotun hands, and the few survivors of the rout in Alderly fled there.
r.Mournwold/Greensward: The Greensward fell without a fight, and the Empire reclaimed the unworked Singing Caves mithril mine. The region is now largely deserted save for monks tending the dead beside a Jotun burial mound.
r.Mournwold/Ore Hills: The Empire besieged and stormed the Tribute after nearly a month, killing almost the entire Jotun garrison. The fort was left a ruin and the Ore Hills were liberated.
r.Mournwold/Southmoor: Probing attacks made some progress, but the Jotun are massed at Hillstop and refuse to parley. A Sentinel Gate conjunction offers heroes a skirmish near the castle.
r.Redoubt/Optarion: The Onyx Path from Optarion to Ateri, guarded by the Citadel of the Flame, remains one of only three passes into Spiral open to an army.
r.Redoubt/Willstone: The Crow Road from Willstone to Cinion remains open to armies. A Sunday conjunction near it offers a chance to intercept a flanking Grendel force.
r.Semmerholm/Axmure: The Druj conquered Axmure in under a month, overrunning secluded manors and scattering the houses of Rylas and de Lusignan.
r.Semmerholm/Estmure: The Gate held for over a month before falling to poison and assault, and the Druj butchered its defenders and burned the castle. Its ruins are the only ground they hold in Estmure, but the rest now lies undefended.
r.Semmerholm/Lacuve: Wealthy Lacuve now lies open to the Druj, and it is expected to fall in coming seasons unless something changes.
r.Spiral/Ankra: The Towerjacks and Citadel Guard pushed into Ankra and the Wolves of War seized its passes into Apstrus. A Grendel force based there may have collapsed the northern passes.
r.Spiral/Apstrus: The Wolves of War and Red Wind Corsairs ambushed the armoured mithril caravan from the Legacy in northern Apstrus, possibly seizing the mine's entire output.
r.Spiral/Ateri: The eastern end of the Onyx Path emerges in Ateri near Fort Mezudan, and the disastrous naval battle was fought in the waters south of it.
r.Spiral/Cinion: The western Imperial armies drove the Grendel out of Cinion entirely. The Crow Road links the region to Willstone.
r.Spiral/Ossuary: The Fire of the South held the Twilight Gate in northern Ossuary and fought cautious skirmishes with the Brine Turtles, but remain penned in by the Grendel.
r.Weirwater/Sandling: A Saturday Sentinel Gate conjunction opens near Sandling, offering a chance to strike the retreating husk army.
r.Zenith/Clypion: Urizen magicians gathered in a black ice citadel raised by the Blazing Sun coven, which became a refuge for fleeing residents. Highborn resistance spared the Halls of Knowledge from the torch.
r.Zenith/Iteri: Mentioned in passing: spires in Iteri welcomed evacuees fleeing the Druj advance.
r.Zenith/Lustri: The Druj took Lustri and raised a citadel of woven trees there, said to house ghulai who torture captured Urizen magicians for their lore.
r.Zenith/Occursion: Occursion fell to the Druj, who used it to launch their advance onto the plains of Proceris.
r.Zenith/Proceris: The Druj made gains in Proceris without taking the region, threatening the Golden Cascade and possibly the Twilight Gate. A Saturday conjunction offers a strike against the Black Wind there.

Allocate the Singing Caves III.d: The Singing Caves, a Bourse seat in Mournwold, had been recovered by the Empire, and Senator Holberg proposed a motion to allocate it, seconded by the senator for Bregasland. During the Senate's discussion a motion of curtailment was passed, but The Throne vetoed it. Senator Holberg then withdrew the motion. As a result the Singing Caves were not allocated that season and the seat remained vacant.

n.The Marches: Senators for two Marcher territories, Holberg and Bregasland, proposed and seconded the motion to allocate a Bourse seat in Marcher-held Mournwold, but Holberg's withdrawal left it unallocated.

t.Mournwold: The Singing Caves in Mournwold had been recovered by the Empire, but their Bourse seat went unallocated this season after the motion was withdrawn.

Amend the use of the Gardens of High Cha.d: Passed in Autumn 381YE, the motion took up an opportunity to use the Gardens of High Chalcis great work in Reikos to support the Great Forest orcs then resident in Therunin. As a result, the herb garden owners of Reikos receive no benefit from the Gardens for the following year, until after the Autumn Equinox 382YE. The Great Forest orcs instead receive a generous supply of herbs. This exceptional act of generosity creates an unrivalled opportunity for a closer relationship between the people of Reikos and the orcs of the Great Forest.

n.Highguard: Highborn herb garden owners in Reikos give up the Gardens' benefit for a year, but in return gain an unrivalled chance to build closer ties with the Great Forest orcs.
n.Navarr: The Great Forest orcs living in Navarri-held Therunin receive a generous supply of herbs.

t.Reikos: The Gardens of High Chalcis in Reikos stop benefiting local herb garden owners until after the Autumn Equinox 382YE, with their bounty sent to the Great Forest orcs instead.
t.Therunin: The Great Forest orcs resident in Therunin receive a generous supply of herbs from the Gardens of High Chalcis.

Amend the use of the Imperial breadbaske.d: Proposed by the senator for Bregasland and seconded by Skarsind in Autumn 381YE, this motion sought a further amendment to the use of the Imperial Breadbasket. Had it passed, the benefits of the breadbasket would have spread to the Mournwold and grown more effective. The cost would have been the permanent loss of the breadbasket's ability to support additional Imperial armies. The Senate did not pass the motion, so the Imperial Breadbasket remained unchanged.

n.The Marches: A Marcher senator from Bregasland put forward the attempt to bring the Mournwold under the Imperial Breadbasket's benefits, but the Marches gained nothing from it because the motion failed.

t.Mournwold: The Mournwold, then held by the Marches, would have been permanently added to the Imperial Breadbasket's reach. The motion's failure left it outside the breadbasket's benefits.

An apple that falls.d: Food from the Marcher Breadbasket, 75 thrones for orc thralls and casualty-limiting advances by Marcher and Imperial Orc armies won some goodwill. Warmage Heilyn Bronwen's Rest undid much of it by backing his predecessor's curse and refusing to rule out repeating it, sparking riots. The Mourn sought protection from Conclave magic, the Singing Caves as a Marcher national resource, the rebuilding of Sarcombe, fortifications held by locals, and acceptance of the Hatred-revering Whittlefolk. Mel Greenhill, Long Tom and Edda Counter would come to Anvil, and a wicker man was being built to burn at the Solstice as a reckoning. Outcomes were deferred to the Winter Solstice winds.

n.Imperial Orcs: Imperial Orc armies, like the Marchers, made a steady advance meant to minimise casualties, helping to blunt claims that the war was simply a slaughter of Jotun.
n.Jotun: Jotun forces were nearly routed but still held two Mournwold regions, including a garrison at Hillstop castle, and had pulled back to Liathaven, where Mournwolders feared they were resupplying for a return.
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: Mournwolders complained it was apparently fine for the Navarr to hate the Jotun while Marchers who Hate them faced condemnation.
n.The League: Senator Cesare and citizens of the twin cities had helped the Whittlefolk settle in Tassato, and the League Assembly could choose to urge Tassatans to report blasphemy among them.
n.The Marches: Marchers won respect for sharing their granaries and limiting casualties, but the Mourn remained close to rebellion. The Marcher Assembly's shunning of the Whittlefolk and its lack of its own Bourse seat both fed the unrest.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: a Marcher judgement noted that the Urizen General had been rebuked by the Synod for the ritual slaughter, which Mournwolders felt was not enough.

t.Bregasland: Bregasland shared in the Marcher Breadbasket supplies sent to the Mourn, and Sister Meredith's mandate there urged Marchers to shun the Whittlefolk.
t.Liathaven: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun had withdrawn to Liathaven, where Mournwolders feared they were resupplying for a renewed attack.
t.Mitwold: Mitwold's fertile farms helped feed the Mourn through the Breadbasket, and Sister Meredith's mandate there urged Marchers to shun the Whittlefolk. Its senator's earlier bid to make the Singing Caves national had been vetoed.
t.Mournwold: The Mournwold was seething after the Warmage's address. Riots broke out and couriers were beaten, and its people sought protection, a share of the mithril, fortifications and acceptance of the Whittlefolk, while a wicker man was raised for a Solstice reckoning.
t.Tassato: Tassato sheltered the Whittlefolk, whose green iron would keep flowing to the Chamber of Commerce. Assemblies might urge Tassatans to give evidence of blasphemy among them.
t.Upwold: Upwold's granaries helped feed the Mourn through the Breadbasket, and Sister Meredith's mandate there urged Marchers to shun the Whittlefolk.

r.Mournwold/Freemoor: Whittle Hill in Freemoor had been liberated, and the Whittlefolk hoped to return there despite fears over their open devotion to Hatred.
r.Mournwold/Green March: Green March was suggested as a site for one of the fortifications the Mourn wanted built against a Jotun return.
r.Mournwold/Greensward: The Greensward's fields had been the scene of the ritual deaths the Mourn demanded a reckoning for, and some who fled the region chose to remain in Tassato.
r.Mournwold/Southmoor: Southmoor still had a Jotun garrison at Hillstop castle. Once it was liberated, the ruined mining town of Sarcombe could be rebuilt, and the region was suggested as a fortification site.
r.Tassato/Tassato Mestra: The Whittlefolk enclave in Tassato Mestra, known as Little Mournwold, would remain home to other Mournwolders even if the Whittlefolk returned to Freemoor.

Appoint Dean of the Liberated.d: The College of the Liberated is a great work in Sarvos, and it carries an associated ceremonial title, the Dean of the Liberated. In Autumn 381YE the Senate considered a motion to appoint someone to the post. Miaren proposed the motion and Feroz seconded it. The outcome was that Venturo de Sarvos was appointed as Dean of the Liberated.

n.The League: A League citizen, Venturo de Sarvos, took up the ceremonial title tied to a great work in one of the League's own territories.

t.Sarvos: The College of the Liberated, a great work in Sarvos, gained a Dean when Venturo de Sarvos was appointed to the title.

Archive:381YE Autumn Equinox Imperial ti.d: The roster listed every territorial senator, the generals of the Military Council, the Synod's cardinals, gatekeepers and virtue inquisitors, the Conclave's archmagi and grandmasters, and the holders of Imperial and national Bourse seats, along with sinecures, ministries, ambassadors and other appointed offices. Several posts were vacant, including the Ambition gatekeeper, the Auditor of Senatorial Accountability, the Dean of Pilgrims and several trade envoys. The Singing Caves awaited allocation by the Senate. Thanmir Hrafnar announced he would stand down as Trade envoy to the Sarcophan Delves at the Winter Solstice. Two national Bourse seats were held by foreigners: the Thule held the Stonefield Ice Caves and the Grendel held the Legacy.

n.Dawn: Dawn held three Senate seats and four generals, including Tancred de Rondell of the Hounds of Glory. Its Synod presence included the Cardinals of Ambition and Wisdom, and Kaywenn du Launcet served as High Bard.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel were listed as holding the Legacy, a Urizen national Bourse seat.
n.Highguard: Highguard held four Senate seats and three generals. Azekah of Zephaniah's Lament was Cardinal of Pride, and Zephaniah of Highguard was Grandmaster of the Order of the Sevenfold Path.
n.Imperial Orcs: Irontide Vio sat as senator for Skarsind, and Bloodcrow Morgur and Irontide Skar led the nation's two armies. Atla was Cardinal of the Way, Bloodcrow Yargol was Advisor on Orc Affairs and Bloodcrow Ergot was Chaplain Consular.
n.Navarr: Navarr held three Senate seats and two generals, Eira Pridestalker and Brennos Brackensong. Its people also served as Warmage (Heilyn) and Quartermaster General (Brendan Brackensong).
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast held four Senate seats and three military commanders, including Admiral Edgardo of the Freeborn Storm. Esteban i Del Rio Blanco i Guerra served as Imperial Fleet Master.
n.The League: The League provided the Empress, Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg, along with four senators and two generals. It also held the Cardinals of Prosperity and Vigilance, and Aureliana Perpetua Nicasia Saverio di Sarvos served as Imperial Consul.
n.The Marches: The Marches held four Senate seats and four generals, including Marius Woodville-Talbot of the Tusks. Martin Orchard served as Imperial Inquisitor and Tess as Gatekeeper of Loyalty.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: the Thule were listed as holding the Stonefield Ice Caves, a Wintermark national Bourse seat.
n.Urizen: Urizen held three Senate seats and a single general, Nicassia Avicia of the Citadel Guard. Its people also served as High Exorcist, Seer of the Gateway and Imperial Censor.
n.Varushka: Varushka held four Senate seats and three generals. Amris was Gatekeeper of Wisdom, Simargl was Dean of the Lyceum and Pavel was Imperial Magus.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark held three Senate seats and two generals, and supplied the Cardinals of Courage and Loyalty and the Conscience of the Senate, Ingrid Sigeing. Its national Bourse seat, the Stonefield Ice Caves, was held by the Thule.

t.Bastion: Mentioned in passing: Sammual, of the Cohort of the Winter Bear, was listed as senator for Bastion.

t.Hercynia: Mentioned in passing: Ranulf Pridestalker was listed as senator for Hercynia.
t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: Irina Arkady Staryn Von Holberg was listed as senator for Holberg.

t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: Cadeus, of the Shattered Tower, was listed as senator for Reikos, and Nemuel of Ravensfell as holder of the Great Forest at Reikos.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: Magdelena Alagna di Sarvos was listed as senator for Sarvos.
t.Segura: Mentioned in passing: Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra was listed as senator for Segura.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: Lady Jocelyn Arwood was listed as senator for Semmerholm.

t.Skarsind: Mentioned in passing: Irontide Vio was listed as senator for Skarsind, and Irontide T'onk as Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato was listed as senator for Tassato, and Edwin Sanguineo di Tassato as Steward of the Tassato Mana Exchange.
t.Temeschwar: Mentioned in passing: Gant Archama was listed as senator for Temeschwar.
t.Therunin: Mentioned in passing: Cybi Farkas was listed as senator for Therunin.

t.Volodmartz: Mentioned in passing: Asya Olya Vikentivich was listed as senator for Volodmartz.
